jscpd reported 152 duplication findings; they are listed and their count does not move the grade: the duplication dimension is scored from the built-in detectors only.

Nothing examined: testing.

These concerns are unmeasured, not clean. Install a tool that covers them, widen analyzers.depth, or declare the SARIF your own build or pipeline already writes in analyzers.pipeline_results to have them reported.

Analyzer children are not network-isolated. 14 external tools ran as local child processes. This agent does not transmit the audited source and opens no socket of its own, but it does not sandbox what it spawns: a third-party analyzer that reaches the network is outside what this run controls or observes. Determinism and no upload are the promise; a kernel air-gap is not.
